Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional rechargeable reading light with a secure clip, uneven brightness, and a charging port hidden under a stiff cover. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I bought the LumaClip reading light for late-night chapters, and the clip is excellent. It grips thick hardcovers securely and never slips. Brightness is another story: the left page glows while the right stays dim, so I keep adjusting the angle. Charging is irritating, too, because the USB-C port hides under a stiff rubber cover that I pry open with a fingernail. It's useful, just not refined.
